_pairings_doc: Authoritative model -> text-encoder / VAE / clip_type pairings, from official ComfyUI docs (docs.comfy.org). Encoders match as a CLASS glob, quant-agnostic (fp8/bf16/fp4/gguf/scaled all fine). This is the knowledge base for selecting a compatible encoder from a host's installed text_encoders/ vae/ folders; the builder graph is separate (some newer families still need their own graph, noted below).

_pairings.builder: NEEDS-GRAPH: 2.x graph differs from 0.9; build from docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/ltx/ltx-2-3

NEEDS-GRAPH: official LTX-2.5 templates now ship natively in ComfyUI - build the graph from them. Encoder gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-*.safetensors; video VAE ltx-2.5-video-vae; audio VAE ltx-2.5-audio-vae; transformer ltx-2.5-22b-{distilled,dev}-transformer-*.safetensors. Verify exact node names against a live host.

NEEDS-GRAPH: FLUX.3 image klein. Encoder = Qwen3-VL-4B (qwen3vl_4b*.safetensors) - NOT the plain Qwen3-4B that flux2-klein uses, and NOT the 8B. VAE = flux2-vae (shared with FLUX.2). Diffusion flux3-image-klein-{bf16,int8-convrot,nvfp4}.safetensors; distilled = 16 steps no guidance, base = 50 steps CFG 3.5. REQUIRES a Qwen3.5-9B prompt upsampler (qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler*.safetensors) that the edit-family builder does NOT yet wire - complete that + verify the exact ComfyUI nodes/clip_type against a live host before trusting a render. Listed BEFORE flux2-klein so its bare '|klein' alternative can't swallow a FLUX.3 model.

_pairings._note: 9B klein pairs with Qwen3-8B (4096-dim), not the 4B. Listed BEFORE flux2-klein so a 9b model can't take the 4B encoder and crash KSampler.

_pairings.builder: PROVISIONAL: no ComfyUI-native nodes yet (SandAI preview); activate when object_info shows its nodes. Reuses Wan2.2 VAE + Qwen3.5-27B encoder.

tts.name: Qwen3TTS-FB-Custom
tts.note: flybirdxx/ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS. The plain TTS node of that pack: speaker comes from an enum of preset voices and instruct is optional.

tts.name: Qwen3TTS-FB-Design
tts.note: Same pack. instruct is a required, non-empty natural-language description of the voice ('A gentle female voice with a high pitch'); the node raises 'Text and instruction description are required' without it.

music.name: AceStep1.5
music.note: 1.5 carries the length on the encode node as `duration` AND on the latent as `seconds`; they have to agree or the sampler and the conditioning disagree about how long the song is.

music.name: AceStep
music.note: Anchored so it cannot claim the 1.5 nodes, which take different inputs.

music.name: MiniMaxMusic3
music.note: Ships as three separate files (diffusion_models/, text_encoders/, vae/) rather than one checkpoint, so it needs the loader trio. Class names verified against the published node reference; the CLIPLoader type value is resolved from the host's own enum.

t2i.name: QwenImage
t2i.note: Base Qwen-Image text-to-image, per the official Comfy-Org template (image_qwen_image_*.json): diffusion_models/qwen_image_fp8_e4m3fn + text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled (CLIPLoader type qwen_image) + vae/qwen_image_vae. It uses the GENERIC CLIPTextEncode node (no distinctive encode node) and a 16-channel EmptySD3LatentImage — so it fits neither the plain-checkpoint path nor _edit_plan, only the t2i-UNET builder. The model regex excludes -edit and -2.1 (those have their own edit families).

t2i.name: Flux
t2i.note: Plain FLUX.1-dev text-to-image — incl. FLUX.1 Krea dev (diffusion_models/flux1-krea-dev) and the community krea2_turbo Flux merges — which fit neither the single-clip t2i path (Qwen) nor _edit_plan (no ReferenceLatent/encode node). Standard Flux rig verified against live /object_info across krea hosts (2026-10-22): UNETLoader + DualCLIPLoader clip_l + t5xxl (type flux) + VAELoader ae.safetensors + EmptyLatentImage + FluxGuidance; KSampler cfg 1, guidance 3.5, euler/simple. flux2/klein/kontext are excluded via lookahead (they have their own edit families and are tried first). Some krea2 hosts also expose a bespoke 'krea2' CLIPLoader type + Krea2-HD-vae; the standard flux rig runs them regardless since krea2 is a Flux merge. The turbo krea2 merges are distilled (fewer steps ideal) but render fine at 20.

edit.name: QwenImage21
edit.note: Qwen-Image-2.1 (released 2026-09; unified t2i + edit — same weights serve both, zero reference images = text-to-image). Loaded as parts: UNETLoader qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot + CLIPLoader qwen3vl_8b (type 'qwen_image') + VAELoader qwen_image_2.1_vae. UNLIKE the other encode families, TextEncodeQwenImage21 is a UNIFIED node: one instance emits positive[0], negative[1] AND the latent[2], and takes required `prompt` + `negative_prompt` (STRING) + `resolution` (INT, default 1024, step 32) plus reference images in a COMFY_AUTOGROW_V3 `images` input named image_1..image_16 — hence encode_unified + the _edit_workflow branch, not the two-encode-node path. cfg 1.0 / 25 steps / euler / simple per the official image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit.json template (cached in dyva/comfy-templates/). Node spec confirmed against a live host's /object_info (2026-10-13).

edit.name: ZImage
edit.note: Z-Image (Tongyi). Encode-style via TextEncodeZImageOmni; the image slots are optional, so with zero references it is text-to-image. Per the official Comfy-Org template (image_z_image_turbo.json) the three files are diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors, text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors, and vae/ae.safetensors — so clip is qwen_3_4b (NOT Qwen2.5-VL, which was an earlier wrong inference) loaded as type 'qwen_image', and the VAE is the plain ae.safetensors autoencoder (NOT Qwen-Image's). clip/vae fallbacks are kept for hosts that name the files differently.

edit.name: Flux2Klein9B
edit.note: FLUX.2 klein 9B pairs with the Qwen3-8B encoder (qwen_3_8b*.safetensors, 4096-dim) — NOT the Qwen3-4B that the 4B klein uses. Feeding the 4B (2560-dim) crashes KSampler with 'mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (512x7680 and 12288x4096)' (7680=2560*3 from the 4B we sent vs 12288=4096*3 the 9B DiT expects); and a 9B host that carries only qwen3-8b was previously rejected as 'no edit model' because the bare Flux2Klein family below demands the 4B file. Listed BEFORE Flux2Klein so '9b' klein matches here first. Verified against docs.comfy.org FLUX.2 klein tutorial and Comfy-Org/vae-text-encorder-for-flux-klein-9b.

edit.name: Flux2Klein
edit.note: FLUX.2 klein (4B) uses Qwen3-4B specifically — not Mistral, and NOT the 8B. The flux2 CLIPLoader for the 4B klein instantiates a 2560-dim Qwen3-4B, so loading an 8B encoder (4096-dim) size-mismatches at render ('embed_tokens.weight 4096 vs 2560'); the clip pattern requires the 4B file, so a host that only has qwen3-8b is skipped rather than crashed. The 9B klein is handled by Flux2Klein9B above. Verified against the FLUX.2 klein model cards and ComfyUI's klein tutorial.

edit.name: Flux2
edit.note: Non-klein Flux.2 uses Mistral-3 small. klein is excluded via lookahead so a klein+Mistral host is rejected at planning, not after a multi-minute render.

checkpoint.name: flux-schnell
checkpoint.note: FLUX.1 schnell is timestep-distilled: 4 steps, CFG 1 (guidance is baked in). https://comfyui-wiki.com/en/tutorial/advanced/image/flux

checkpoint.name: flux
checkpoint.note: FLUX.1 dev / general flux checkpoints: ~20-28 steps, CFG 1 on a bare KSampler (dev is guidance-distilled; real guidance rides a FluxGuidance node this basic graph lacks). Euler+Simple; avoid Euler-Ancestral on distilled models.

checkpoint.name: turbo
checkpoint.note: SD/SDXL Turbo and SD3.5-Large-Turbo are adversarial-distilled for 1-4 steps at CFG 1; negative prompts have no effect.

checkpoint.name: lightning
checkpoint.note: SDXL Lightning ships 2/4/8-step variants; a step count in the filename (e.g. _4step) overrides this. Low CFG.

checkpoint.name: hyper
checkpoint.note: ByteDance Hyper-SD; 1/2/4/8-step variants - filename step count overrides. CFG-preserved variants take 5-8.

checkpoint.name: lcm
checkpoint.note: Latent Consistency: 4-8 steps, low CFG, needs the LCM sampler + sgm_uniform scheduler.

checkpoint.name: sd3
checkpoint.note: SD3 / SD3.5 Large: ~28-40 steps, CFG ~4.5. (Turbo variant caught above.)
